Row.Text: "With extraordinary thunder and a flame that illuminated, then blackened, all surroundings, the rod set the stone violently in motion."
"Either I take the city or the city takes me."
"If the tulip cups are absent, bring the wine cups instead."
"We deem it appropriate to provide the provinces of the Ottoman Empire the benefit of a good administration through new institutions."

+25% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production towards [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SIEGE_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Siege[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_INFANTRY_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Infantry[/TIP] Units. -2 [icon:YIELD_GOLD] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_MAINTENANCE_TOOLTIP]Gold Maintenance[/TIP] for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_LAND_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Land Units[/TIP].
+3[icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness from displayed [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_GREAT_WORKS_TOOLTIP]Great Works[/TIP]. +15% [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production towards constructing Museums.

+3 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture on [icon:CITY_UNIQUE_QUARTER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTRICT_TOOLTIP]Quarters[/TIP] with at least 1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Building[/TIP]. +3 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness on [icon:CITY_UNIQUE_QUARTER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTRICT_TOOLTIP]Quarters[/TIP] with at least 1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Building[/TIP].

+5 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture on [icon:CITY_UNIQUE_QUARTER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTRICT_TOOLTIP]Quarters[/TIP] with at least 1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Building[/TIP]. +5 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness on [icon:CITY_UNIQUE_QUARTER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_DISTRICT_TOOLTIP]Quarters[/TIP] with at least 1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_BUILDINGS_TOOLTIP]Building[/TIP].

When a unit destroys a [icon:CITY_FORTIFIED] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_FORTIFIED_DISTRICTS_TOOLTIP]Fortified District's[/TIP] defenses, all other [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_LAND_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Land[/TIP] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SIEGE_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Siege[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_INFANTRY_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Infantry[/TIP] Units have their [icon:Action_Move] Movement restored.

+5 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMBAT_STRENGTH_TOOLTIP]Combat Strength[/TIP] for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SIEGE_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Siege Units[/TIP]. +1 [icon:UNIT_MOVEMENT_ICON] Movement for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SIEGE_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Siege[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SUPPORT_UNIT_TOOLTIP]Support Units[/TIP].

+5 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMBAT_STRENGTH_TOOLTIP]Combat Strength[/TIP] for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SIEGE_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Siege Units[/TIP]. +1 [icon:UNIT_MOVEMENT_ICON] Movement for [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SIEGE_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Siege[/TIP] and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SUPPORT_UNIT_TOOLTIP]Support Units[/TIP]. Training a [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SIEGE_UNITS_TOOLTIP]Siege Unit[/TIP] grants [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness towards [icon:CELEBRATION] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_CELEBRATIONS_TOOLTIP]Celebrations[/TIP] equal to 50% of the Unit’s [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production cost.
